name: FormData validates form and submitter ownership
html: <form id="f"><input id="text"><button id="reset" type="reset"></button></form><form id="other"><button id="foreign"></button></form>
source: const f=document.getElementById('f');for(const run of [function(){new FormData(null);},function(){new FormData(document.body);},function(){new FormData(f,document.getElementById('text'));},function(){new FormData(f,document.getElementById('reset'));},function(){new FormData(f,document.getElementById('foreign'));}])try{run();}catch(e){record(e.name);}record(Array.from(new FormData(f,null)).length);
